title: Operation Identity Authority Contract Composition
scope: operation identity runtime algebra and upstream authority composition
authority contract metadata and backward-compatible entry point
route producer, operation identity projection, CLI and SDK consumer trace
AST/ADT, semantic dataflow, manifest, graph, IR, and React regression boundaries

results.name: operation identity authority has a dedicated executable contract
results.detail: The authority contract specializes the existing runtime algebra without duplicating its operation signature.

results.name: authority composition accepts the runtime algebra contract
results.detail: Authority composition depends on the behavioral contract rather than a concrete algebra shape.

results.name: authority composition delegates construction exactly once
results.detail: The authority does not reconstruct identity, evidence, derivation, provenance, or proof.

results.name: canonical production authority is bound to the canonical algebra
results.detail: The production implementation is selected once at the upstream authority boundary.

results.name: authority metadata is closed and upstream-owned
results.detail: The composed authority advertises its ownership and closed contract explicitly.

results.name: existing public function remains backwards compatible
results.detail: Existing single-argument callers keep working; explicit composition can be supplied for tests or alternate runtime wiring.

results.name: authority entry point does not import semantic derivation logic
results.detail: No second identity classifier was introduced at the authority wrapper.

results.name: algebra preserves the exact upstream reasoning proof
results.detail: The closed capability forwards existing reasoning evidence and provenance.

results.name: algebra does not classify method or path
results.detail: Identity capability construction seals an existing route identity rather than deriving a new one.

results.name: route producer continues to use the upstream authority entry point
results.detail: The route producer remains connected to the authority boundary.

results.name: operation identity projection remains a consumer-only wiring contract
results.detail: Downstream receives a closed identity reference, not an executable reasoning algebra.

results.name: CLI projects capability identity rather than reclassifying routes
results.detail: CLI generation consumes the canonical upstream capability.

results.name: SDK remains fail-closed when upstream identity is absent
results.detail: SDK does not reconstruct operation identity from method/path as a fallback.

results.name: AST dataflow uses canonical semantic ADT aliases
results.detail: AST remains a producer boundary over canonical input and judgment types.

results.name: dataflow reasoning contract remains shared and upstream-owned
results.detail: Dataflow does not introduce a second local judge signature.

results.name: dataflow runtime adapter only projects an upstream-closed judgment
results.detail: Upstream manifest production owns reasoning; runtime adapter only forwards the closed judgment and proof.

results.name: manifest projection does not own dataflow closure
results.detail: Manifest projection forwards upstream-closed judgments and policy contracts without rerunning semantic reasoning.

results.name: graph projection retains structural relation semantics
results.detail: Graph relations remain distinct from value/dataflow closure.

results.name: IR consumes closed upstream dataflow state
results.detail: IR does not rerun the semantic solver.

results.name: React hooks consume endpoint capability instead of route classification
results.detail: Frontend hooks continue to rely on resolved endpoint capability.

results.name: public exports include the new authority contract and composition factory
results.detail: The contract is accessible without forcing consumers to import an internal file path.

results.name: audit is reproducible and package build contract is unchanged
results.detail: The audit is registered without changing package version or build command.

decision.change: Added an explicit authority interface and a composition factory that accepts OperationIdentityCapabilityContractMaterializerInterface.
decision.reason: The prior authority wrapper delegated to the canonical algebra but had no explicit compositional contract for runtime wiring or substitutable verification.
decision.preserved: The canonical algebra remains the sole identity capability constructor; route producers and downstream projections preserve their existing behavior.
